# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent = cand_0002 (val 0.533). Diagnosed THIS iteration's ./trajectories/ (cand_0002 rollouts)
with 3 parallel read-only subagents (418-29, 53161, 347-49) + direct trace/gold reads (47484,
160-6, 52216) + read the scorer source. Merged 3 additive prompt rules + 2 pre-finish checklist
items into this one candidate.

## Key scorer fact established this iteration (resolves a stale memory error)
`evaluation.py::transform_value` coerces a numeric STRING via `round(float(v),2)`, so str "01"
and int 1 BOTH become float 1.0 and compare EQUAL (type check passes — both float). Therefore
47484's gold is int 1,2,3… yet the trials that wrote str "01".."03" scored 1.0. **47484 is NOT a
type failure** (the "str where int expected" feedback line is a red herring); its flakiness is a
VALUE/interpretation error. (Corrects the memory note claiming 47484 gold = leading-zero strings.)

## Ranked issue list (leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | row DELETION = compaction (shift up) | 418-29 (0.67); reinforces 347-49 (0.33) | Failing trial "deletes" by clearing cells IN PLACE → blank gaps + stale trailing rows. Gold compacts survivors to the top, blanks the bottom. Prompt's "a blank stays blank / leave cells in place" nudges the wrong way; no rule gave deletion its Excel shift-up semantics. | KNOWLEDGE (new rule) + STRUCTURE (checklist) | prompt.md rule + checklist item |
| 2 | computed 0 in a fully-defined grid must be written | 53161 (0.67) | Gold fills all 208 grid cells incl. literal 0 (34/42/53 zeros). Failing trial guarded writes with `if any_found` → left 34 computed-0 cells blank. It OVER-APPLIED the absolute "never pad with 0" bullet. | CONTRACT narrowing + STRUCTURE (checklist) | prompt.md clarification + checklist item |
| 3 | per-group running-number interpretation | 47484 (0.67, cand_0002 regression) | Gold = running occurrence count WITHIN each (A,B) key group (1st occ→1, 2nd→2…). Failing trial assigned one id per DISTINCT key. Pure interpretation variance (2/3 trials read it correctly). | KNOWLEDGE (interpretation rule) | prompt.md rule |
| 4 | code-as-deliverable misread | 347-49 t2 (part of 0.33) | Instruction "I need a VB code that…"; t2 wrote VBA macro SOURCE TEXT into cell A1 (corrupting it). The deliverable is the RESULT of the operation, never code text. Recurs across the benchmark (many tasks phrased "write a macro/VB code that…"). | KNOWLEDGE (new rule) | prompt.md rule |
| — | DATA DEFECTS (handed back, NOT fixed) | 55457, 32468, 374-9 | see "Deliberately skipped" | — | none |

## Changes made (3 prompt rules + 2 checklist items; 4 distinct improvement types)
| cluster | lever/type | file | what & why it generalizes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | new KNOWLEDGE rule (Excel deletion semantics, with WHY) | prompt.md | "Delete/remove rows ⇒ survivors SHIFT UP; write remaining rows contiguously from the top, blank the freed bottom rows; do not clear in place / leave stale trailing rows; this is the one exception to leave-cells-as-they-were." Generalizes to every dedup / delete-blank-rows / delete-block task. |
| 1 | STRUCTURE (pre-finish check) | task_template.md | Checklist item: after a deletion, verify survivors are contiguous at top, freed rows blank, no gap/stale row — makes compaction a precondition of finishing. |
| 2 | CONTRACT narrowing | prompt.md | Clarifies the "never pad with 0" bullet: it forbids inventing values for UNDEFINED cells; it does NOT permit leaving a COMPUTED cell blank — a legitimately-computed 0 in a fully-defined grid is written as literal 0; match a worked example grid's fill density. |
| 2 | STRUCTURE (pre-finish check) | task_template.md | Checklist item: no computed grid cell left blank; a computed 0 is written as 0 (undefined cells may stay blank). |
| 3 | KNOWLEDGE interpretation rule | prompt.md | "Sequential/running number keyed on column(s) ⇒ count OCCURRENCES within each key group in row order (restart per key); do NOT assign one number per distinct key." |

## Verify-the-fix (evidence → edit)
- 418-29 t1 (fail; t0/t2 pass): t1 wrote net into `first_row` then set duplicate cells to None IN PLACE → rows 3,5 blank, rows 6-7 stale (feedback: "empty where value expected [3,5]; value past where answer ends [6,7]"). Gold V1 = survivors r1-r5 contiguous, r6-r7 blank (verified). Deletion=compaction rule + checklist make t1 compact like t0/t2. Generalizes; no hardcoding.
- 53161 t2 (fail; t0/t1 pass): t2 `if any_found: results[...]` skipped zero-count cells → 34 blank (coverage 174/208). Gold fills all 208 incl. literal 0 (verified 34/42/53 zeros, all int). Computed-0 clarification + checklist make t2 write the 0s.
- 47484 t2 (fail; t0/t1 pass): t2 assigned seq per DISTINCT (A,B) pair → C=01,01,02,03,03,03,02; gold V1 = 1,2,1,1,2,3,2 = per-occurrence running count (verified all 3 variants). Group-number rule pins the correct reading. (Type is irrelevant — scorer coerces numeric strings, see scorer fact above.)
- 347-49 t2 (fail): t2 ran `ws["A1"] = "\n".join(vba_lines)` — wrote VBA source text into A1 — and hardcoded example spans. "Deliverable is the RESULT, never code text" rule stops the A1 corruption; could lift 347-49 0.33→~0.67. Safe: no passing task writes code into cells (40467 writes formatted text LABELS, not code).

## Blast-radius per edit (all BOUNDED / ADDITIVE or NARROWING — none loosens a global rule)
- Deletion=compaction: BOUNDED — triggers only when the instruction deletes/removes rows. Reinforces passing 160-6 (gold VERIFIED compacts: r6-r8 filled, r9-r11 blank). No effect on 40467/52216/47484 (no deletion). 347-49 already used delete_rows (native compaction) → reinforced, not changed.
- Computed-0 clarification: NARROWING of the anti-pad rule (adds a predicate: "computed cell ⇒ write it"). Safe for 52216 (gold fills all 10 lookup cells — VERIFIED, no intentional blanks), 160-6 (trailing cells are UNDEFINED → still blank), 47484/40467 (all cells defined & filled). Does not force filling any cell a passing task leaves blank.
- Group-number rule: ADDITIVE — triggers only on "sequential number keyed on columns." No passing task performs per-group numbering. Cannot change 40467/52216/160-6/53161.
- Checklist items: STRUCTURE — gate conditions phrased as "if <deletion>/<computed grid>"; on tasks without that condition they are vacuously satisfied (no behavior change on 40467/52216/160-6).
- No edit hardcodes any task id/value/date/answer. No deletion of existing rules (the anti-pad and "leave cells as they were" rules are kept; deletion rule states its explicit, scoped exception).

## Process & features used
- FANNED OUT 3 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents (one per recoverable cluster) to
  diagnose against the real trajectories + ground-truth xlsx, plus direct reads for the passing
  anchors (160-6, 52216) and the scorer source. Applied edits serially into this one candidate.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not undo)
- "Prefer LITERAL output values over formulas" (formula lever regressed 52216/53161 in memory).
- The "keep text as text / never coerce date-like text or leading-zero labels" clause (guards 160-6, 47484, 40467).
- The type-preservation, "don't pad with 0", read-extent, label-alignment, data_only, and
  worked-example-authoritative rules from cand_0001/cand_0002 (kept intact; only clarified/added around).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457 — DATA DEFECT: `instruction` is a single U+00A0 (empty). Unwinnable by any prompt.
- 32468 — CORRUPTED GOLD (verified in memory): DISCOUNT!row2508 = 6.5 in every input but −7 in every
  answer, so gold SUMIFS was computed on a mutated cell; cell-level all-or-nothing ⇒ unwinnable.
- 374-9 — GOLD DEFECT: variants 2/3 double only the top-8 state rows with no distinguishing input
  signal ⇒ ceiling 1/3. The recoverable data_only bug is already fixed (cand_0002). No per-task hack.
- 347-49 — PARTIALLY addressed. t2's code-into-A1 bug IS fixed (new "deliverable is the result, not
  code" rule). t1's residual (deletes too few rows — stops at the non-blank "Employee Info" label) is
  a reasoning-variance gap already targeted by cand_0002's worked-example-authoritative rule; adding
  more prose = redundant emphasis. I SKIPPED a subagent-proposed "do not stop scanning at the first
  non-blank row" addition: it carries a real REGRESSION risk for passing 160-6 (pure blank-row delete —
  that nudge could make a weak reader over-delete a data row). Too dangerous for uncertain gain. Next
  lever for t1: an in-context worked EXAMPLE of block deletion, scoped so 160-6 can't over-delete.
